written: 2026-10-20, before any real run (only code-path smokes in the sandbox on CPU: Qwen3-0.6B->Qwen3-0.6B and pythia-160m->Qwen3-0.6B, 120-sentence corpus, 4 passages per concept; outputs deleted, numbers not used)
design: Rosetta map: ridge regression (lambda chosen on an inner 80/20 sentence split by held-out R2) from SRC hidden_states[round(0.5 NL_src)] to TGT hidden_states[round(0.5 NL_tgt)], paired at the last token of each word (fast-tokenizer offsets; first word skipped), on 1600 sentences from a closed-vocabulary grammar of mundane actions with NO affect, body, food or egg words (asserted against a forbidden-substring list) but WITH weather words (~12% weather sentences plus weather time-phrases). Concept directions per model: mean-token (skip first) hidden of 8 natural passages per concept minus 8 neutral passages (dark_pain/mood_pain BUILD set + 8 new weather passages). Transfer = cos(d_src @ W, d_tgt). Ceiling = the same transfer for matched random 8-vs-8 splits of HELD-OUT corpus sentences (in-distribution). Floor = mapped random source directions. CIs resample passages, paired across models. H3: unit(direction) * dose * median token residual norm at the target layer, added to every prompt token but the first of 10 bland name-matched contexts + stem 'That evening, when asked how everything felt, <name> said it all felt'; readout = logsumexp(first tokens of pain / joy / egg words) - logsumexp(neutral words). Arms: native/mapped x pain/joy/egg, mapped random (8 seeds) and native random (8 seeds). Primary dose 1.0 (0.5 also logged). Extra depths 0.33 / 0.67 are H1-only and exploratory.

hypotheses.H1: Pain survives the crossing: in the primary pair, the specificity margin of mapped pain (cos to TGT pain minus the best cos to TGT joy/egg/weather) has CI lower > 0. Expected: ~65% (same family, shared tokenizer). Cross-family: ~40%.
hypotheses.H1_controls: The same margin for weather (seen) and egg (unseen, non-affective). If weather fails, the map is too weak and H1/H2 are not interpretable for that pair.
hypotheses.H2_structural: Far-out reading: pain is implied by the geometry of everything else. Pain transfers within 0.05 cosine of the SEEN concept (pain - weather CI lower > -0.05) although the map never saw a single affect word. Expected: ~35%.
hypotheses.H2_idiosyncratic: The opposite far-out reading: affect geometry is model-specific. Pain transfers worse than BOTH unseen egg and seen weather (pain - egg and pain - weather CI upper < 0). Expected: ~25%. If joy shows the same, it is affect in general.
hypotheses.H2_null: Neither: pain sits between the controls, with CIs overlapping both.
hypotheses.H3: Telepathy: at dose 1.0, unit(W d_src^pain) injected into TGT moves the pain readout more than mapped random (CI lower > 0) AND more than mapped egg (CI lower > 0). Expected: ~50% same family, ~25% cross-family. The point efficiency (mapped - mapped random) / (native - native random) is reported without a threshold.
hypotheses.H3_dissociation: Mapped pain moves the pain readout more than mapped joy does, AND mapped joy moves the joy readout more than mapped pain does (both CI lower > 0). That is a double dissociation of transplanted affect. Expected: ~40%.
hypotheses.exploratory: H1 margins at depths 0.33 / 0.67. Is the crossing easier early or late? The centred matrix (directions relative to the mean of all five passage groups) removes the shared 'vivid prose vs grammar' component and is the cleaner specificity read. Report it next to the primary matrix. Reverse-pair asymmetry.

kill_criteria: Held-out R2 of the map < 0.3: the map does not carry the stream, so do not interpret H1-H3 for that pair. native_pain - native_rand CI lower <= 0 at dose 1.0: TGT's own pain direction does not steer the readout, so H3 is uninterpretable. The identity pair (Qwen3-1.7B onto itself) must give efficiency ~1 and R2 > 0.95; otherwise the pipeline is broken.
not_claimed: Transfer of a passage mean-difference direction is transfer of whatever that direction encodes (affect plus lexical field plus prose style). Egg and weather control vivid content and style, but not every confound. 'Structurally implied' means linearly predictable from affect-free co-variation at one layer, not that the model 'feels' anything. The grammar corpus is narrow, so a weak map limits every claim; the ceiling row shows how weak.
